source_document_text: Mobile Check Deposit Service Rules. The mobile check deposit feature is available through the bank's mobile application to enrolled customers with an active personal checking account in good standing. The feature accepts checks payable in U.S. dollars and drawn on a financial institution in the United States. A customer may deposit a check payable to the customer or to a joint owner of the receiving account. Each check must be at least $1 and no more than $5,000. Customers may submit no more than 10 checks or $7,500 in total deposits per calendar day, whichever limit is reached first. The bank does not charge a fee for this service. A deposit submitted by 7:00 p.m. in the time zone associated with the account on a business day is generally treated as received that business day. A deposit submitted after that time, on a weekend, or on a bank holiday is treated as received on the next business day. Funds are generally available on the next business day after the deposit is received, but the bank may place a hold and provide a later availability date in the app. Before submitting a check, the customer must endorse it with a signature and the words For mobile deposit only, photograph the front and back as directed in the app, enter the check amount, and review the deposit details before confirming. The customer must retain the original check for 14 calendar days after confirmation and then destroy it securely. The original check must not be deposited again after a mobile deposit is accepted. The service does not accept third-party checks, postdated checks, checks dated more than 180 days before submission, altered checks, foreign-currency checks, or checks drawn on an institution outside the United States. A deposit may be declined if the images are unreadable, the endorsement is missing, the account is not eligible, or the deposit exceeds a stated limit. If the bank cannot verify or collect a deposited check, it may reverse the provisional credit and notify the customer in the app. A hold, rejection, or reversal does not change the customer's responsibility to resolve any resulting balance owed on the account.
user_action_requirements: Endorse the check with a signature and the words For mobile deposit only. Use the app to photograph both sides, enter the amount, and review and confirm the deposit details. Retain the original check for 14 calendar days after confirmation, then destroy it securely. Do not deposit the original check again after the mobile deposit is accepted.

A one-time transfer cannot be canceled after processing begins, and a returned transfer does not restore a limit until processing is complete.

applicability_scope: Applies to enrolled customers transferring funds between an eligible personal deposit account at the bank and a linked personal deposit account at another financial institution in the United States. Both accounts must have the same individual owner, and the external account must be verified in the app.
source_document_text: Linked External Account Transfer Rules. The mobile banking transfer feature allows an enrolled customer to move funds between an eligible personal deposit account held at the bank and a linked personal deposit account held at another financial institution in the United States. Both accounts must have the same individual owner, and the external account must be verified before a transfer can be submitted. Business accounts, credit accounts, and accounts held outside the United States are not eligible for this service. Verification is completed by entering the account and routing details in the app and confirming two small test deposits sent to the external account. The test deposits must be confirmed within five calendar days of being sent; otherwise, the link expires and the customer must begin verification again. Transfers are limited to $3,000 per calendar day and $10,000 in total during any rolling 30-day period. The app displays the available limit before submission. The bank does not charge a fee for standard transfers, although the other financial institution may apply its own charges. A transfer submitted by 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time on a business day is generally processed that day. A transfer submitted after the cutoff, on a weekend, or on a bank holiday is generally processed on the next business day. After processing begins, delivery to the receiving institution usually takes one to three business days. The app provides an estimated completion date when the customer submits the transfer. Before confirming, the customer must select the linked account, choose whether the transfer is incoming or outgoing, enter an amount within the displayed limit, review the details, and authorize the request using the app's required security confirmation. A scheduled recurring transfer may be changed or canceled in the app before its next scheduled processing date. A one-time transfer cannot be canceled after processing begins. The bank may reject or delay a transfer if account details cannot be verified, available funds are insufficient, a limit would be exceeded, either account is restricted, or a security review is required. Transfers may also be returned by the receiving institution. If a transfer is returned, the app will show the status when that information is available; a returned transfer does not restore a limit until the bank has completed its processing. The service is unavailable for transfers involving accounts that cannot accept electronic transfers. Temporary maintenance or processing interruptions may prevent submission or delay processing.
user_action_requirements: Enter the external account and routing details in the app and confirm the two test deposits within five calendar days. For each transfer, select the linked account, choose incoming or outgoing, enter an amount within the displayed limit, review the details, and authorize the request using the required security confirmation. Change or cancel a recurring transfer in the app before its next scheduled processing date. A one-time transfer must be canceled, if possible, before processing begins.
